newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita Electric to form Thailand battery firm.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita Electric to form Thailand battery firm.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd and a fully owned subsidiary, Matsushita Battery Industrial Co Ltd, plan to set up a new company in Thailand to produce batteries, Matsushita Electric said on Thursday.
The new company, Matsushita Battery (Thailand) Co Ltd, will manufacture manganese dry batteries, lead-acid storage batteries for automobiles, and flashlights, it said.
The new company will be established in December and begin production in April 1997.

The new company will be capitalised at 955 million Thai baht and owned 60 percent by Matsushita Electric Industrial and the rest by Matsushita Battery Industrial, a company statement said. The company expects to produce 350 million manganese dry batteries, 700,000 lead-acid storage batteries for automobiles and 500,000 flashlights in 1997. The company will employ 555 people initially, it said.
